authority.user_request: Audit whether 0.1.1 implemented RAG, agentic search and research; align frozen 0.1.1 and current 0.1.2 with the PRD; reorganize missing capabilities into 0.1.2 and later S0-S5 plans.

identified_planning_gap.root_cause: The consolidated FIN 0.1.2 plan described runtime, deterministic truth, model surface and frozen-evidence artifact proof in detail, but did not assign explicit current-version gates for F01-F15, natural Case entry, live public/local agentic search, bounded graph drilldown, current Workbench projection and exact Human Review.
identified_planning_gap.impact: A successful frozen-input S3 could be misread as FIN 0.1 Agentic Search/Research and product-surface completion even though source network and external tools are disabled.
identified_planning_gap.selected_fix: Keep S0-S2 and current S3 unchanged; rebaseline S4 into eight fixed evidence-to-workbench product qualification tasks and S5 into six exact release tasks. Preserve FIN 0.2 Earnings scope.

later_version_policy.FIN_0_2: Earnings Review Alpha starts at its own S0 after FIN 0.1 exact candidate; it does not absorb unfinished FIN 0.1 generic runtime, agentic search or workbench debt.
later_version_policy.FIN_0_3: Review and Memory Beta owns correction reuse, follow-up, selective refresh and bounded R4.
later_version_policy.FIN_0_4: Cross-sector Beta owns sector-pack, graph, numeric and judgment generalization.
later_version_policy.FIN_0_5: Enterprise Pilot owns private Data Room, tenant isolation, RBAC and enterprise audit.
